description: Bulk-export the articles in a licence order you hold. Returns up to 1000 articles per call (collected from line-delimited JSON wire format). Same content contract as list_feed: full text for AI training orders only; every other order exports metadata (content_body null) — use get_content for article text. Each exported article is recorded for analytics; a bulk export is not billed per article. Use `since` (ISO 8601) for delta-feed. Use `cursor` to paginate beyond 1000. Backend supports 5000 articles per call; the MCP cap is 1000 for transport reasonability. Real bulk-ingest pipelines should use the Python SDK (pip install opedd) directly — not via MCP. Credentials as list_feed: OPEDD_ACCESS_KEY (ent_*) OR your buyer API key + order_id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the prior result's meta.next_cursor

order_id.description: The licence order to export (UUID). Used with a buyer API key; ignored with an ent_* key.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — return only articles with published_at > since

name: stream_feed_ndjson
title: Export a licence order's articles
